trades.reasoning: Highest-scoring candidate (100) with full multi-signal confirmation — bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge — justifying deployment of idle cash even on a neutral market day.

decisions.briefing: Markets were roughly flat today (NASDAQ -0.2%, S&P 500 -0.3%), a neutral session with no clear directional catalyst. With $889 in cash and 3 open slots, we deployed a portion into PLBL, the only candidate showing all five bullish signals including a volume surge, while leaving remaining positions untouched per our rule of not exiting strong holdings on quiet days.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with NASDAQ down 0.2% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%, reflecting a quiet, directionless session rather than any major news-driven selloff. No single catalyst dominated headlines, so trading stayed range-bound. This kind of low-volatility, mixed-signal day is typical between major economic data releases or earnings cycles.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市窄幅整理，納指微跌0.2%，標普500指數跌0.3%，並無重大消息主導市場，屬於方向不明的淡靜交易日。市場缺乏單一催化劑，成交在區間內波動。此類低波動、訊號混雜的日子，通常出現在重要經濟數據或業績公佈之間的空檔期。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A MACD crossover happens when a stock's short-term momentum line moves above its signal line, often seen as an early sign that buying pressure is building. Traders combine it with other signals, like RSI and volume, to confirm a genuine trend rather than a false alarm. Today's buy candidate showed this crossover alongside several other confirming signals.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: MACD黃金交叉是指股票的短期動能線升穿訊號線，通常被視為買盤力量增強的早期跡象。交易者會配合其他指標（如RSI及成交量）一併確認，以避免誤判為假訊號。今日選中的買入標的正正同時出現此交叉及多個其他確認訊號。
